Name: Kenneth's Massive Farm - Ultra Tall
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Okay this one is insane - true mega vertical.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]80x260 = 20,800 tiles, 4x vanilla. Same width as normal farm but 4 times taller downwards. It's massive vertical, you can build a whole town going down. My biggest tall version for endgame farms where you never want to run out of space.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All 20,800 tiles are tillable.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Standard: Overwrites Standard Farm for old saves.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Additional Farms: Custom farm type for new game, with Day 1 mail that fixes the old furniture disappearance bug and returns your stuff.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Needs SMAPI + Content Patcher. Works on 1.6.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This is Kenneth's Massive Farm - Ultra Tall. If 80x195 Super Tall is not enough, this is it.[/b][/size]
